result.reason: The redline brings the Customer’s termination right within the fallback by retaining 90 days’ notice and capping the Termination Payment at three months’ fees. However, it also retains HDI’s mutual right to terminate on 90 days’ notice at any time, rather than limiting HDI’s convenience termination right to the end of a committed term as required by the fallback. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the existing commercial structure, though the clause should expressly distinguish convenience termination from termination for breach and restrict HDI’s right to non-renewal at term end.
